1452584885096284160.author: lastasylum
1452584885096284160.content:
In <Last Asylum: Survival>, there are a variety of buildings, each with unique features.
Almost all buildings can be upgraded to a higher level by clicking the green arrow.Upgrading buildings boosts your strength and unlocks additional bonuses.
The level of each building is always capped at the current level of the Sanctuary. Building upgrades require strategic planning around the Sanctuary level. Prioritize upgrading the Sanctuary, use Builder's Hut to reduce construction time, and gradually enhance Research, Barracks, Training Grounds, and Infirmary based on your needs. This balanced approach ensures might and resource growth, preventing issues like restricted troop training or stagnant progress.Below is a breakdown of the core functions of key buildings.

**Sanctuary**
The Sanctuary is the most vital building, as it dictates the max level of all other structures.
After upgrading the Sanctuary, the following stats will increase:
•Might
•Hero Level Cap
•Hero HP
•Hero ATK
•Hero DEF
•Building Level Cap
Additionally, upgrading the Sanctuary will also:
•Grant EXP rewards (EXP gain shown in upgrade image);
•Unlock new buildings.

1452584885096284160.author: lastasylum
1452584885096284160.content:
Builder's Hut

In the early game, when your base is below Lv.15, the Builder's Hut will be your most valuable asset.
This building grants you free construction speedups.By keeping the Builder's Hut at the same level as the Sanctuary, you can rapidly upgrade numerous other structures.
Here, you can see which survivors are working in this building.You can also replace existing Survivors with others who offer higher bonus effects.

1452584885096284160.author: lastasylum
1452584885096284160.content:
Research Lab

Scientific research is essential for boosting your might. In the Research Lab, you can study various technologies to gain a wide range of buffs and bonuses.
Both might cultivation and economic development can receive significant numerical boosts through tech research.

1452584885096284160.author: lastasylum
1452584885096284160.content:
Barracks & Training Grounds
    
These two buildings often cause confusion due to their similar themes, but their functions are distinct:
Barracks are for upgrading troop types; Training Grounds are for expanding troop type capacity.

1452584885096284160.author: lastasylum
1452584885096284160.content:
Infirmary

When you suffer a defeat in battle, some of your soldiers won't be killed outright; instead, they'll be critically injured and sent to the Infirmary.This is the Infirmary's core function: healing wounded troops.
How it works:
Troops injured in battle are sent to the Infirmary.
You need to consume certain resources (such as Gold, Medicine, or time) to heal these troops.
Once healing is complete, troops will recover to full health and rejoin your army for future battles.

Many more buildings await your exploration in the game. Master the rhythm of building upgrades and lay a solid foundation for your base. This way, you'll be able to face challenges in the post-apocalyptic world of Last Asylum: Survival with greater confidence and continuously grow your power!

# How to Join Alliance
**1. Find Alliance**
The Alliance feature will be officially unlocked once your Sanctuary reaches Level 5.
Follow these steps to find an alliance:
1.Tap the [Alliance] button in the bottom-right corner of the main game screen;
2.Once in the Alliance interface, view the list of alliances recommended by the system.
￮Recommendations are usually based on activity level, rankings, or proximity.
3.Alternatively, use the search function to enter an alliance name or ID and locate a specific alliance.

**II. Submit an Application**
After selecting your desired alliance, tap [Apply to Join]:
•Open Alliances: You'll be admitted immediately after submitting your application.
•Approval-Required Alliances: You'll need to wait for review and approval from the alliance admins.
Once your application is approved, the system will send you a notification confirming your successful alliance membership.
You can then participate in alliance events, donate resources, and interact with your fellow members.

1452585657166856325.author: lastasylum
1452585657166856325.content:
# How to Choose the Right Alliance

Picking an alliance that suits your playstyle will drastically elevate your gaming experience:
🔹 Alliance Activity
•Prioritize alliances with highly active members;

•Active alliances complete quests faster and offer more generous rewards;
•Keep an eye on member online status and chat frequency to gauge activity.
🔹 Alliance Level & Rankings

•High-level, top-ranked alliances typically offer stronger tech buffs and larger resource reserves;
•Note that these alliances may impose requirements on member might or activity levels.
🔹 Alliance Goals & Playstyle
•Casual Players: Opt for laid-back, friendly alliances with no strict requirements;
•Competitive Players: Choose alliances that prioritize wars and rankings as their core goals.
🔹 Language & Communication

•Join an alliance where members speak a common language; this will greatly facilitate coordination and quest collaboration

1452585657166856325.author: lastasylum
1452585657166856325.content:
# Overview of Core Alliance Gameplay

**I. Alliance Technology**
•Earn Alliance EXP by assisting fellow members or making daily tech donations.
•Upgrading Alliance Technology levels grants powerful permanent buffs to all alliance members.

**II. Alliance Shop**
•Stock refreshes every Monday
•Exchange Alliance EXP for a variety of valuable items:
￮Recruit Ticket;
￮Construction Speedups;
￮Other critical development resources.

This is a key way to boost your base construction and overall might growth.

**3. Alliance Gifts**
•Alliance members earn Alliance Gifts by completing designated quests.

•Claiming gifts increases your Gift Level.

•Higher Gift Levels unlock richer rewards and additional alliance features.

**4. Alliance Help**
•Members can assist each other to reduce quest and construction time.

•This speeds up base development and hero training, drastically improving your overall efficiency.

Doctors, join an alliance today!
Team up with your allies to explore more events, dispel the shadow of the plague together,
and build your ideal home step by step!🌱

1452586519821947001.author: lastasylum
1452586519821947001.content:
Antitoxin is a crucial resource for character progression and overall might growth. It can be primarily obtained through three methods: daily gameplay, event rewards, and pack purchases.

**I. Daily Gameplay**
1. Antitoxin Workshop & Stable Production
•Antitoxin Workshop produces antitoxins at regular intervals.
•The higher the level of the Antitoxin Workshop, the more antitoxins you'll get per unit time.
•Antitoxins can be collected via the Stable, making it one of the stable sources of antitoxins.

1452586519821947001.author: lastasylum
1452586519821947001.content:
**2. Building Upgrade Rewards**
•All buildings in your base will grant a certain amount of Antitoxins upon completion of an upgrade.
•As the building level increases, the amount of Antitoxins obtained will gradually rise.

1452586519821947001.author: lastasylum
1452586519821947001.content:
**3. Falcon Quest**
    
•Completing Falcon Quests rewards you with Antitoxins.

•The amount of Antitoxins varies depending on the level of the Falcon Quest.
•Most Falcon Quests include Antitoxin rewards, so we recommend prioritizing their completion.

1452586519821947001.author: lastasylum
1452586519821947001.content:
** 4. Covert Ops Force & Caravan Trade**
•Both completing Covert Ops Force Quests and Caravan Trade will earn you Antitoxins.
•You can get antitoxins whether you complete your own quests or plunder others'.

•Each player can plunder others' Covert Operation up to 5 times per day.
•The amount of Antitoxins obtained from Covert Operation varies by color, with Golden Covert Operations offering the highest rewards.

**5. Blight & Elite Blight**
•Spend 10 Stamina to hunt Blight.
￮Defeating Blight of different levels yields abundant Antitoxins.
•Spend 20 Stamina to challenge Elite Blight.
￮Defeating Elite Blight of different levels earns you abundant Antitoxins.
This is a cost-effective way to consume Stamina and acquire Antitoxins.

1452586519821947001.author: lastasylum
1452586519821947001.content:
**II. Event Rewards**
Participating in in-game events allows you to earn generous rewards. Take the Cheese Trap Event as an example.

•Join Cheese Trap-related events.
•Earn Event Points based on your individual kill count and your alliance's total kill count.
•Different Point tiers correspond to different amounts of antitoxin rewards, with overall rewards being very generous

**III. Pack Purchase**
•You can obtain Antitoxins directly by purchasing packs.

•This option is suitable for players who want to quickly level up and shorten their growth cycle.

**Summary**
The best way to acquire Antitoxins and accelerate growth is to arrange your daily gameplay strategically, actively participate in events, and choose packs to supplement based on your own situation.
By consistently engaging in high-reward gameplay, your Antitoxin accumulation will be quite substantial.

1452587435383980144.content: To gain an advantage on the battlefield, team composition and cultivation strategy are crucial. Overall, building a powerful squad can be approached from three core aspects: lineup, positioning, and unit type.

1452587435383980144.author: lastasylum
1452587435383980144.content:
**I. Lineup Development Priority: Plan First, Then Invest**


Before cultivating heroes, you first need to clarify the development direction of your main lineup. Different unit types have varying formation rhythms. Choosing a direction in advance avoids resource waste.
We recommend focusing on developing a single main lineup for the long term, concentrating resources on leveling up and equipping these heroes. This growth efficiency is significantly higher than developing multiple lineups simultaneously.
Recommended Early-Stage Hero Lineup:
Frontline: Arthur, Bella
Backline: Marlena, Claire, Celia

1452587435383980144.author: lastasylum
1452587435383980144.content: During the cultivation process, prioritize enhancing core damage dealer characters. For example, the gear of main attack units should be upgraded first. In the early stage, we highly recommend focusing on cultivating the UR Hero Marlena.

1452587435383980144.author: lastasylum
1452587435383980144.content:
Additionally, heroes experience a significant power boost after reaching 4 stars. This should be set as a key phased goal.

**II. Unit Type: Counter & Lineup Bonuses
**
Effectively utilizing unit type features is a crucial way to widen the might gap with opponents.

1452587435383980144.author: lastasylum
1452587435383980144.content: **Unit Counter**

1452587435383980144.author: lastasylum
1452587435383980144.content:
The three unit types form a counter cycle:
Warrior＞Ranger＞Warlock＞Warrior
In battles, selecting unit types that counter the enemy's lineup can often help you defeat stronger opponents.

1452587435383980144.author: lastasylum
1452587435383980144.content:
**Same-Unit Type Lineup Bonuses**

Using heroes of the same unit type in your team triggers additional attribute boosts (HP, ATK, DEF). The more same-type heroes you have, the higher the bonus:
•3 same-type heroes: 5% attribute increase
•4 same-type heroes: 15% attribute increase
•5 same-type heroes: 20% attribute increase
This makes building a same-unit type lineup an excellent choice for your main team, as it delivers substantial overall benefits.

1452587435383980144.author: lastasylum
1452587435383980144.content:
**III. Positioning: Secure a Stable Attack Environment**
In battles, reasonable positioning maximizes the value of each hero. The basic positioning principle is:

1452587435383980144.author: lastasylum
1452587435383980144.content:
•Frontline: Assigned to defensive heroes. Their role is to absorb enemy damage and protect backline units.
•Backline: Place attack and support units here to provide sustained damage output and support effects.
A stable frontline is the foundation for the backline to exert its full potential. Only with proper positioning can you maintain a favorable battle rhythm.

**Summary**
Clarify your lineup direction, skillfully use unit countering, arrange positions reasonably, and concentrate resources on cultivating core heroes.
May all Doctors find the lineup that suits them best,
achieve continuous victories on the battlefield, and fully enjoy the thrill of combat!🎯

1452588183970644079.author: lastasylum
1452588183970644079.content:
In <Last Asylum: Survival>, the overall Might of your heroes determines your progress speed and combat efficiency. A formidable hero team will help you build your ideal new world in record time.
Below is a breakdown of the core essentials for hero cultivation.

# Hero Might
Hero Might is determined by four core attributes:
**Hero Might = Level + Star Rating + Skills + Gear**
Allocate resources wisely to enhance these four aspects for maximum might growth.

1452588183970644079.author: lastasylum
1452588183970644079.content:
**I. Hero Level & Star Rating: The Foundation of Might Growth**
Heroes of different rarities boast varying base might, with Orange Heroes being the rarest. Rarity Tiers: Orange > Purple > Blue.

1452588183970644079.author: lastasylum
1452588183970644079.content:
As your shelter level increases, the hero's level cap will also rise.Hero level not only directly affects the base might value but also amplifies the bonus from skills and gear.
**Star Rating system** is equally crucial, as it:

1452588183970644079.author: lastasylum
1452588183970644079.content:
•Determines a hero's base might;
•Influences whether hero skills can be unlocked.
Upgrading hero Star Rating will unlock more potent skill effects and greater growth potential.

**II. Hero Skills: Key Driver of Might Growth**

1452588183970644079.author: lastasylum
1452588183970644079.content:
Additional stat bonuses provided by hero skills are an indispensable part of boosting your overall might.
From the Hero interface, you can:
•Check the detailed stats and effects of each skill;
•Spend certain items to upgrade unlocked skills.
Higher skill levels yield more substantial might gains, making skill enhancement a pivotal way to pull ahead of the competition in the mid-to-late game.

**3. Hero Gear: The Cornerstone of Might Enhancement**
Each hero has 4 gear slots for equipping different types of gear.

1452588183970644079.author: lastasylum
1452588183970644079.content:
🔹 **Gear Quality Tiers**
Gear quality is indicated by color, ranked from highest to lowest as follows:
Gold ＞ Purple ＞ Blue ＞ Green ＞ Gray
In the  [Gear Workshop], you can consume crafting materials to forge higher-quality gear for your heroes.The higher the gear quality, the stronger its base stats and growth potential.

🔹 **Benefits of Gear Upgrading**
•Upgrading gear unlocks additional bonus stats;
•High-level, high-quality gear delivers a massive boost to hero might.
We recommend prioritizing high-level golden gear for your core heroes to drastically improve their combat performance.

1452588183970644079.author: lastasylum
1452588183970644079.content:
**IV. Resource Allocation Tips: Focused Cultivation = Maximum Efficiency**
When resources are scarce, we advise you to:
•Prioritize developing your main lineup heroes;
•Channel all EXP and high-quality gear into your core lineup.
Avoid spreading your resources too thin. This is the only way to maximize your combat advantage in key battles.

Map out a clear growth path for your heroes' levels, star ratings, skills, and gear, and you'll forge a truly unstoppable team.
Doctors, forge your ultimate roster of heroes,
and savor the glory and challenges that await you on the battlefield! 💥

1452590514284138547.author: lastasylum

**I. Hero Might: The Most Critical Might Source for New Players**

Heroes are the most cost-effective system for boosting might in the early game.
•Prioritize developing your main squad.
Concentrate all resources on a single core lineup.
•Prioritize upgrading hero levels
A hero's level determines their base Might and amplifies the benefits from skills and gear.
•Focus on core DPS heroes first
Allocate EXP, gear, and skill materials to your main DPS hero with top priority.
•Star Rating matters more than quantity.
High-star heroes provide drastically significant improvements in stats and skills.

1452590514284138547.author: lastasylum
1452590514284138547.content:
**II. Raven Bonus: Steady Growth, Late-Game Powerhouse**

The Raven provides stable, continuous bonuses to your entire team, yet it's often overlooked by new players in the early game.
Open Raven Gear Chests and fuse higher-level Raven Gear to gain additional stats.
We recommend upgrading your Raven level by completing daily quests to unlock more Might bonuses.

1452590514284138547.author: lastasylum
1452590514284138547.content:
**III. Building Upgrades: The Foundation of Might and Development**

Buildings are prerequisites for all in-game systems, so the upgrade order is crucial.
Prioritize upgrading the Sanctuary first. It unlocks more features and increases the level cap for all other buildings.
Subsequently focus on upgrading the Barracks, Research Lab, and other key buildings, as they directly affect your soldier capacity and technology research speed.

*Click here to access: https://discord.com/channels/1417476085179748507/1452584885096284160

1452590514284138547.author: lastasylum
1452590514284138547.content:
**IV. Soldier Training: The Primary Source of Might**

Keep your Training Grounds running continuously. Prioritize training high-level troop types and gradually replace low-level soldiers with stronger ones.

1452590514284138547.author: lastasylum
1452590514284138547.content:
**V. Technology Research: An Underestimated Long-Term Might Boost**

Technologies provide permanent bonuses and are the key to pulling ahead of other players in the mid to late game.
Prioritize researching combat and development technologies to enhance ATK, DEF, HP, training speed, construction speed, and other vital attributes.

You can choose the most suitable way to boost your might based on your available resources in the game, and cultivate an even more powerful team!

1452586519821947001.author: lastasylum
1452586519821947001.content:
Antitoxin is a crucial resource for character progression and overall might growth. It can be primarily obtained through three methods: daily gameplay, event rewards, and pack purchases.

**I. Daily Gameplay**
1. Antitoxin Workshop & Stable Production
•Antitoxin Workshop produces antitoxins at regular intervals.
•The higher the level of the Antitoxin Workshop, the more antitoxins you'll get per unit time.
•Antitoxins can be collected via the Stable, making it one of the stable sources of antitoxins.

1452586519821947001.author: lastasylum
1452586519821947001.content:
**2. Building Upgrade Rewards**
•All buildings in your base will grant a certain amount of Antitoxins upon completion of an upgrade.
•As the building level increases, the amount of Antitoxins obtained will gradually rise.

1452586519821947001.author: lastasylum
1452586519821947001.content:
**3. Falcon Quest**
    
•Completing Falcon Quests rewards you with Antitoxins.

•The amount of Antitoxins varies depending on the level of the Falcon Quest.
•Most Falcon Quests include Antitoxin rewards, so we recommend prioritizing their completion.

1452586519821947001.author: lastasylum
1452586519821947001.content:
** 4. Covert Ops Force & Caravan Trade**
•Both completing Covert Ops Force Quests and Caravan Trade will earn you Antitoxins.
•You can get antitoxins whether you complete your own quests or plunder others'.

•Each player can plunder others' Covert Operation up to 5 times per day.
•The amount of Antitoxins obtained from Covert Operation varies by color, with Golden Covert Operations offering the highest rewards.

**5. Blight & Elite Blight**
•Spend 10 Stamina to hunt Blight.
￮Defeating Blight of different levels yields abundant Antitoxins.
•Spend 20 Stamina to challenge Elite Blight.
￮Defeating Elite Blight of different levels earns you abundant Antitoxins.
This is a cost-effective way to consume Stamina and acquire Antitoxins.

1452586519821947001.author: lastasylum
1452586519821947001.content:
**II. Event Rewards**
Participating in in-game events allows you to earn generous rewards. Take the Cheese Trap Event as an example.

•Join Cheese Trap-related events.
•Earn Event Points based on your individual kill count and your alliance's total kill count.
•Different Point tiers correspond to different amounts of antitoxin rewards, with overall rewards being very generous

**III. Pack Purchase**
•You can obtain Antitoxins directly by purchasing packs.

•This option is suitable for players who want to quickly level up and shorten their growth cycle.

**Summary**
The best way to acquire Antitoxins and accelerate growth is to arrange your daily gameplay strategically, actively participate in events, and choose packs to supplement based on your own situation.
By consistently engaging in high-reward gameplay, your Antitoxin accumulation will be quite substantial.
